basis: Coordinator review of the six byte-exact stage1 requests. No axes inferred from candidates, operator posture, object orientation or format success.

review_notes.low_horizontal_portrait_ko: Positive horizontal direction plus exclusion of upward tilt; not negative-only direction.
review_notes.upward_object_en: Upward belongs to the wooden rocket, not the capture camera.
review_notes.background_camera_ko: The actual capture is higher and downward; the ceiling-facing shelf camera is depicted background.
review_notes.two_cameras_en: The assistant's separate camera is the actual capture owner and points upward. Seated operator posture does not prescribe capture height.
